description: The Political “Experts” Told Me Not to Do ThisI did it anyway.They told me to just write short meaningless statements on issues without taking any firm positions or writing anything that someone might not agree with.They told me to write like this one from my opponent’s “Issues” page on crime:“I will work with law enforcement, first responders, and community leaders to ensure our public safety professionals have the resources they need.”Come on. That could have been written by any candidate, in any state, running for any office, in any year.It tells you absolutely nothing.Now – and I know this is a “radical” idea – I think you deserve to know more about the person asking to represent you in Carson City than just their name on a ballot.So instead of giving you the usual list of short, content-free talking points written by some “professional” consultant…I wrote a book!It’s called The Kitchen Table Agenda: One Mom’s Answers for the Problems Politicians Ignore.
